question: _____ is a translation service and information site developed jointly by the Central Institute of Indian Languages, Sahitya Akademi and National Book Trust in 2002.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Anukriti .net.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anukriti.net **is a website that provides information on** Sanskrit language **and **literature.**
 
• Anukriti.net is a** translation service and information** site developed jointly by the **Central Institute of Indian Languages, Sahitya Akademi and National Book Trust in 2002.**
 
• It was developed by the **Rashtriya Sanskrit Sansthan**, an autonomous organization under the** Ministry of Human Resource Development.**
 
• It offers resources for learning and studying **Sanskrit language** and literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Praroop.net** is a website that provides information on **Indian languages and scripts**.

 
 
• It was developed by the **Centre for Development of Advanced Computing** (C-DAC) in Pune.
 
• It offers tools and resources for** learning and using various** Indian languages.
 
 
 
• **Anuvaad.net** is a website that offers** machine translation services** for Indian languages.
 
 
• It was launched by the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology **(MeitY) in 2019.
 
• It uses **artificial intelligence and machine learning **algorithms to provide accurate translations.
 
 
 
• **Pratilipi.net** is a website that offers a platform for Indian language writers and readers.
 
 
• It was founded in** 2014** and has a collection of over **400,000 books** and stories in various Indian languages.
 
• It allows users to **read, write, and share stories** in their preferred Indian language.
